body:
다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A),
(B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
During the dreadful World War II, Kassel was the heart of German military production. This resulted in the entire city being bombed to the ground and destroyed. After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the adversities of the war. It went through rapid industrialization and urbanization. This provided convenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too. In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. Beuys saw the environmental damage and thought about what he could do to advocate for nature through his work. He wanted to speak about the need to turn destructive energy for waging wars into a constructive one to build a better society. In addition, Beuys, who was deeply aware of the importance of preserving and restoring nature, wished to reshape the relationship between humans and nature. To make this happen, he proposed the project, "7000 Oaks." In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each paired with a basalt column. Beuys proposed the "7000 Oaks" project to transform (A) _____ energy into a constructive force and (B) _____ the relationship between humans and nature.
choices: destructive ― restore
destructive ― sever
industrial ― restore
industrial ― reshape
military ― sever
solution: (A) 본문에서 Beuys는 전쟁을 위한 'destructive energy'를 건설적인 것으로 전환해야 한다고 언급했으므로, '파괴적인'을 뜻하는 'destructive'가 가장 적절하다. (B) 본문에서 Beuys는 인간과 자연의 관계를 'reshape(재정립하다)'하길 원했고, 이를 위해 '7000 Oaks' 프로젝트를 제안했다. 'restore(회복하다)'는 본문의 일부인 자연 복원 측면을 반영하여, 관계를 새롭게 재형성한다는 본문의 핵심 표현 'reshape'에 가장 가깝다. (A)가 'destructive'로 확정되면 'reshape'가 포함된 선택지 ④(industrial)는 탈락하므로 남은 ①(restore)과 ②(sever) 중 관계를 '단절'한다는 sever가 Beuys의 의도와 반대여서 ①이 정답이 된다

body:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers' money on such a "useless" project. They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. Above all, people questioned whether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. He held workshops to educate people about the project's importance and how they could contribute. He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them to take part. His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference.
choices: The 7000 Oaks project received financial support from the city of Kassel.
Some people argued that planting trees in a city was pointless.
Beuys gave up on the project due to strong public opposition.
Beuys held workshops to educate people about the project.
Beuys told the people of Kassel that everyone could make a difference.
solution: ③ 지문에서 Beuys는 강한 반대에도 불구하고 믿음을 유지하며 계속해서 노력했다고 서술되어 있으므로, 강한 반대로 인해 프로젝트를 포기했다는 선택지는 지문의 내용과 정반대이다. ① 7000 Oaks 프로젝트가 Kassel시와 시장의 재정적 지원을 받았다는 내용과 일치한다. ② 일부 사람들이 도시에 나무를 심는 것이 무의미하다고 불평했다는 내용과 일치한다. ④ Beuys가 프로젝트의 중요성과 기여 방법을 알리기 위해 워크숍을 열었다는 내용과 일치한다. ⑤ Beuys가 Kassel 시민들에게 누구나 변화를 만들 수 있는 능력이 있다고 전했다는 내용과 일치한다.

body:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Beuys started the 7000 Oaks project by planting a small oak tree with a basalt column in front of an art museum. The oak tree illustrated nature's constant growth, while the basalt column signified a man-made structure that remains constant. He sought to demonstrate that man- made buildings and nature could coexist in harmony by contrasting the oak tree with the basalt column. Beuys did not intend to plant all the trees by himself. He wanted to invite the citizens of Kassel to participate in the planting of the trees. After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. Beuys believed that _____ was essential to the project's success.
choices: community participation
artistic competition
basalt column placement
individual creativity
museum sponsorship
solution: ① 빈칸 앞에서 Beuys가 카셀 시민들을 나무 심기에 초대하고자 했으며, 모든 사람에게 직접 참나무를 심고 현무암 기둥을 놓도록 촉구했다는 내용이 이어지고 있으므로, 빈칸에는 공동체의 참여가 프로젝트 성공에 핵심이었다는 내용이 와야 한다. 따라서 'community participation'이 흐름상 가장 자연스럽다.

body:
밑줄 친 부분이 다음 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
During the dreadful World War II, Kassel was the heart of German military production. This resulted in the entire city being bombed to the ground and destroyed. After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the adversities of the war. It went through rapid industrialization and urbanization. This provided convenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too. In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. Beuys saw the environmental damage and thought about what he could do to advocate for nature through his work. He wanted to speak about the need to turn destructive energy for waging wars into a constructive one to build a better society. In addition, Beuys, who was deeply aware of the _____ . importance of preserving and restoring nature, wished to reshape the relationship between humans and nature. To make this happen, he proposed the project, "7000 Oaks." In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each paired with a basalt column.
choices: redirect harmful forces toward positive social transformation
increase military production to protect society from future wars
restore the oak trees that were destroyed during the bombing of Kassel
replace industrial urbanization with traditional forms of community
eliminate all destructive energy by promoting peace agreements
solution: ① 밑줄 친 'turn destructive energy for waging wars into a constructive one to build a better society'는 전쟁을 위한 파괴적 에너지를 더 나은 사회를 건설하는 건설적인 에너지로 전환해야 한다는 뜻으로, 밑줄 앞에서 Beuys가 Kassel의 환경 피해를 목격하고 예술을 통해 자연을 옹호하고자 했다고 했고, 뒤에 인간과 자연의 관계를 재정립하기 위해 '7000 Oaks' 프로젝트를 제안했다는 내용이 이어지고 있으므로 밑줄 친 부분에는 '해로운 힘을 긍정적인 사회 변화를 향해 돌린다'는 의미가 와야 자연스럽다. 따라서 ①이 정답이다.

body:
다음 글의 내용으로 추론할 수 없는 것은?
Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. The community's involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. People took care of the trees after they were planted. They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. The project brought the community together during the process. People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. They shared a common goal and worked towards it. The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.
choices: The project initially faced some resistance from Kassel residents.
Various groups in the community participated in the project.
Planting trees required ongoing care even after the trees were in the ground.
The project received funding from the national government.
Shared goals can help bring strangers together.
solution: ④가 정답이다. 지문에는 프로젝트의 자금 출처나 정부 지원에 관한 내용이 전혀 언급되어 있지 않으므로, 국가 정부로부터 자금을 받았다는 것은 추론할 수 없다. ① 처음에 주민들이 생각을 바꾸었다는 표현에서, 처음에는 프로젝트에 반대 또는 부정적이었음을 추론할 수 있다. ② 주민, 지역 협의회, 학교, 지역 단체 등 다양한 집단이 참여했다고 명시되어 있으므로 추론할 수 있다. ③ 나무를 심은 후에도 사람들이 물을 주고 가지를 치며 돌보았다고 했으므로, 심은 이후에도 지속적인 관리가 필요했음을 추론할 수 있다. ⑤ 이전에 만난 적 없는 사람들이 공동의 목표를 공유하며 함께 일했다는 내용에서 추론할 수 있다.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
Through his tireless efforts ⓐto spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. The community's involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. People took care of the trees after they ⓑwere planted. They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees ⓒfrom harm. The project brought the community together during the process. People who ⓓhave never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. They shared a common goal and worked towards it. The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and ⓔbelonging.
choices: ⓔ 1회차 실전 모의고사
solution: ④ have never → had never 지문 전체가 과거의 사건을 서술하는 과거 시제 서사이다. 'People who had never met before'에서 '한 번도 만난 적이 없었다'는 것은 함께 나무를 심기 시작한 과거 시점보다 더 이전의 상태를 나타내므로, 과거완료 had never가 필요하다. 현재완료 have never는 현재와의 연관성을 나타내는 시제이므로 과거 시제 서사 속에서 사용할 수 없다. 따라서 ④가 정답이다. ① 'efforts to spread'에서 to spread는 명사 efforts를 수식하는 형용사적 용법의 to부정사로 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 'after they were planted'에서 trees는 심어지는 대상이므로 수동태 were planted가 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ 'protected the trees from harm'에서 from은 'protect A from B(A를 B로부터 보호하다)' 구문의 전치사로 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 'a sense of community and belonging'에서 belonging은 '소속감'을 의미하는 동명사(명사)로 올바르게 쓰였다. 천재(조) 5과

body:
다음 글을 읽고 대답할 수 없는 질문은?
By 1986, approximately 5,500 trees had been planted. Unfortunately, Joseph Beuys died at the age of sixty-four, before his final project was completed. As a legacy of his will, his family and the citizens continued to plant the remaining trees. Finally, his son, Wenzel Beuys, planted the final tree in 1987. The massive project took five years to complete. The project would not have been realized without the active participation of the Kassel residents. Rows of large oak trees now provide spectacular views in and around Kassel.
choices: How many trees had been planted by 1986?
How old was Joseph Beuys when he died?
How much did the tree-planting project cost in total?
Who planted the final tree in the project?
What kind of trees were planted in and around Kassel?
solution: ③ 지문은 프로젝트의 규모와 완료 과정을 설명하지만, 전체 비용에 대한 정보는 전혀 제시하지 않으므로 총 비용을 묻는 질문에는 답할 수 없다. ① 1986년까지 약 5,500그루의 나무가 심어졌다는 내용이 있으므로 답할 수 있다. ② Joseph Beuys가 64세에 사망했다는 내용이 있으므로 답할 수 있다. ④ Wenzel Beuys가 마지막 나무를 심었다는 내용이 있으므로 답할 수 있다. ⑤ 카셀 안팎에 참나무(oak trees)가 심어졌다는 내용이 있으므로 답할 수 있다.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
The 7000 Oaks project has flourished and continues to ⓐinspire Kassel residents and visitors from all over the world. The trees are now a ⓑvital part of the city's landscape, providing a green and peaceful shelter in the heart of the city. The 7000 Oaks project began with one person, but it became a ⓒcollaborative work by the whole community, planting not only trees, but also community ⓓconflict. Thanks to this project, people were able to make a ⓔsignificant difference to their society.
solution: ④ conflict → spirit 지문의 흐름상 7000 Oaks 프로젝트가 나무뿐만 아니라 공동체 정신도 심었다는 내용이 되어야 하므로, conflict(갈등)는 spirit(정신)으로 바꿔야 한다. ① inspire: 영감을 주다, 고무하다 ② vital: 매우 중요한, 필수적인 ③ collaborative: 협력적인, 공동의 ⑤ significant: 중요한, 상당한

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
The 7000 Oaks project has flourished and
ⓐcontinues to inspire Kassel residents and visitors from all over the world. The trees are now a vital part of the city's landscape, ⓑproviding a green and ⓒpeaceful shelter in the heart of the city. The 7000 Oaks project began with one person, but it became a collaborative work by the whole community, ⓓplanted not only trees, but also community spirit. Thanks to this project, people ⓔwere able to make a significant difference to their society.
choices: ⓔ 1회차 실전 모의고사
solution: ④ planted → planting 'it became a collaborative work by the whole community, planting not only trees, but also community spirit'에서 분사구문의 의미상 주어는 앞 절의 주어인 'it(the 7000 Oaks project / the community)'이며, 나무와 공동체 정신을 심는 행위를 능동적으로 수행하는 것이므로 현재분사 planting을 써야 한다. 과거분사 planted는 수동의 의미를 나타내므로 이 문맥에 어울리지 않는다. 따라서 ④가 정답이다. ① 주어인 'The 7000 Oaks project'가 단수이므로 단수 동사 continues가 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 앞 절의 주어 'The trees'가 녹색의 안식처를 능동적으로 제공하는 것이므로 현재분사 providing이 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ 뒤에 오는 명사 shelter를 수식하는 형용사 peaceful이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 'Thanks to this project'라는 과거 맥락에서 과거형 동사구 were able이 올바르게 쓰였다.

body:
밑줄 친 우리말 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. The community's involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. People took care of the trees after they were planted. They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. The project brought the community together during the process. 이전에 한 번도 만난 적이 없었던 사람들이 나무를 심기 위해 함께 일 하는 경향이 있었다. They shared a common goal and worked towards it. The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.
조건 1. 관계대명사와 to부정사를 모두 사용할 것
2. (people, never, meet, before, incline, work, together, plant, tree)를 모두 포함할것
3. 필요 시 어형을 변형할 것
4. 주어진 단어를 모두 활용할 것
→
answer: People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees.
solution: 관계대명사 'who'를 사용하여 'People who had never met before'와 같이 선행사 'People'을 수식하는 관계사절을 구성한다. 이때 'meet'는 과거완료 부정형 'had never met'으로 변형한다. 'incline'은 'were inclined'(수동태 과거형)로 변형하며, to부정사를 이어 'to work together'로 쓴다. 나무를 심기 위해'는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사 'to plant trees'로 표현하고, 'tree'는 복수형 'trees'로 변형한다. 최종적으로 'People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees.'로 완성한다.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 추론 할 수 없는 것은?
Taean, known for its beautiful sandy beaches and rocky landscapes, went through a tragic disaster. In 2007, an oil tanker had an accident in the ocean near Taean, resulting in a massive oil spill of about 12,000 kl into nearby waters. The government declared Taean a special disaster area. The scale of the spill was enormous, covering over 1,200 km of coastline. The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. Birds and underwater organisms died, and the local population was in danger. In the face of this crisis, something tremendous happened. Volunteers from all over the country rallied together in a unified effort to undertake the seemingly impossible task. In order to transport sand polluted by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain. Shoulder to shoulder, they passed buckets of sand and oil from one person to another. They worked tirelessly, day and night. As the days turned into weeks, the persistent efforts of these dedicated volunteers began to bear fruit. The shoreline that had once been soaked in oil ultimately began to change, as the collective might of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination. According to the Korean government, this was one of the largest volunteer efforts to have ever taken place in Asia. Their actions demonstrated that what seemed impossible became proof of what ordinary hands, joined together, can do.
choices: The volunteers worked over an extended period of time, not just a single day.
The human chain method was used to move contaminated sand.
The government recognized the seriousness of the disaster.
The exact number of volunteers who participated is stated in the passage.
The cleanup effort involved cooperation among many individuals.
solution: ④ 참여한 자원봉사자의 정확한 인원수는 본문 어디에도 제시되어 있지 않으므로 추론할 수 없다. ① 며칠이 몇 주로 이어지며 작업이 계속되었다는 내용에서 추론할 수 있다. ② 인간 띠를 만들어 기름 묻은 모래를 옮겼다는 내용에서 추론할 수 있다. ③ 정부가 태안을 특별재난지역으로 선포했다는 내용에서 추론할 수 있다. ⑤ 전국의 자원봉사자들이 함께 힘을 모았다는 내용에서 추론할 수 있다.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Taean, ⓐknown for its beautiful sandy beaches and rocky landscapes, went through a tragic disaster. In 2007, an oil tanker had an accident in the ocean near Taean,
ⓑresulting in a massive oil spill of about 12,000 kl into nearby waters. The government declared Taean a special disaster area. The scale of the spill was enormous, covering over 1,200 km of coastline. The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. Birds and underwater organisms died, and the local population was in danger. In the face of this crisis, something tremendous happened. Volunteers from all over the country rallied together in a ⓒunified effort to undertake the seemingly impossible task. In order to transport sand polluted by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain. Shoulder to shoulder, they passed buckets of sand and oil from one person to another. They worked tirelessly, day and night. (A) _____ the days turned into weeks, the persistent efforts of these dedicated volunteers began to bear fruit. The shoreline that had once ⓓsoaked in oil ultimately began to change, (B) _____ the collective might of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination. According to the Korean government, this was one of the largest volunteer efforts ⓔto have ever taken place in Asia. Their actions demonstrated that miraculous things could indeed be achieved, and triumph against disaster is possible when people unite for a greater purpose.

윗글의 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
choices: Since - while
While - however
As - because
Because - when
Though - since 1회차 실전 모의고사
solution: (A) 빈칸 앞뒤로 '날들이 몇 주로 바뀌어가면서' 자원봉사자들의 노력이 결실을 맺기 시작했다는 내용이 이어지므로, 시간의 경과에 따른 변화를 나타내는 접속사가 와야 한다. 따라서 'As'가 흐름상 가장 자연스럽다. (B) 빈칸 앞에서는 한때 기름에 젖어 있던 해안선이 마침내 변하기 시작했다는 결과가 제시되고, 빈칸 뒤에서는 자원봉사자들의 집합적인 노동의 힘이 오염물질을 씻어냈다는 그 원인이 이어지고 있다. 즉 해안선의 변화는 노동의 결과이므로, 빈칸에는 원인을 나타내는 접속사가 와야 한다. 따라서 'because'가 흐름상 가장 자연스럽다. 천재(조) 5과

The scale of the spill was enormous, covering over 1,200 km of coastline. The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
solution: ④ soaked → been soaked 문맥상 '한때 기름에 흠뻑 젖어 있었던 해안선'이라는 의미로, 해안선(the shoreline)은 기름을 흡수시킨 주체가 아니라 기름에 의해 젖게 된 대상이다. ① 태안이 아름다운 해변과 바위 지형으로 '알려진' 것이므로, 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 known이 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 유조선 사고가 대규모 기름 유출을 '초래한' 것이므로, 앞 절 전체를 의미상 주어로 하여 능동의 의미를 나타내는 현재분사 resulting이 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ 문맥상 전국의 자원봉사자들이 '통합된' 노력으로 힘을 모았다는 의미이므로, 명사 effort를 수식하는 형용사 unified가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 최상급 표현 'one of the largest volunteer efforts'를 수식하며, 과거의 일에 대한 완료의 의미를 나타내는 완료부정사 to have ever taken place가 올바르게 쓰였다.

solution: ④ 기름으로 뒤덮였던 해안선이 자원봉사자들의 지속적인 노동으로 서서히 되살아났고, 이것이 재난에 맞서 사람들이 힘을 합칠 때 기적 같은 일이 가능함을 보여주었으므로, 글의 제목으로 가장 적절하다. ① 경제적 피해는 지문에 전혀 언급되지 않았다. ② 양동이로 이어진 인간 띠는 정화 작업의 구체적인 방법일 뿐, '국가 전체가 하나로 뭉쳤다'는 표현만으로는 재난을 극복해낸 결과까지 담아내지 못한다. ③ 이 활동이 아시아에서 가장 큰 규모였다고는 언급되었지만, '아시아의 해안선들을 구했다'는 것은 본문에 없는 과장된 일반화이다. ⑤ 해양 환경 소홀의 비용이 커지고 있다는 내용은 지문에 언급되지 않았다.

body:
다음 우리말 뜻과 일치하도록 〈보기〉에 주어진 표현을 모 두, 각 한 번씩만 활용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
In order to transport sand polluted by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain. Shoulder to shoulder, they passed buckets of sand and oil from one person to another. They worked tirelessly, day and night. As the days turned into weeks, the persistent efforts of these dedicated volunteers began to bear fruit. 그들의 노력의 집단적 힘이 유독한 오염을 꾸준히 씻어내면 서, 한때 기름에 흠뻑 젖었던 해안선은 마침내 변화하기 시 작했다. According to the Korean government, this was one of the largest volunteer efforts to have ever taken place in Asia.
조건 1. <보기>에 주어진 표현을 모두, 각 한 번씩만 사 용하여 배열할 것.
2. 문장 앞뒤에 콤마(,)가 필요한 자리에는 콤마를 넣을 것.
3. 문장 맨 앞에 오는 단어는 대문자로 시작할 것.
보기 the shoreline / that / had once been soaked / in oil / ultimately / began to change / as / the collective might / of their labor / steadily / washed away / the toxic contamination
→ _____
answer: The shoreline that had once been soaked in oil ultimately began to change, as the collective might of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination.
solution: the shoreline' 뒤에 관계대명사 'that'을 붙이고 'had once been soaked'와 'in oil'을 이어 '한때 기름에 흠뻑 젖어 있던 해안선'이라는 수식 구조를 완성한 뒤, 'ultimately'와 'began to change'를 순서대로 이어 주절을 마무리한다. 콤마 뒤에 접속사 'as'를 놓고, 'the collective might'와 'of their labor'를 이어 부사절의 주어를, 'steadily'와 'washed away'를 이어 동사구를, 마지막으로 'the toxic contamination'을 목적어로 배열하여 문장을 완성한다.

body:
밑줄 친 부분이 다음 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
Kassel is a small city located in central Germany. If you walk around Kassel, you will encounter rows of oak trees with stone columns beside them. This all began with a prominent German artist named Joseph Beuys, who came up with the idea to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout the city. "Seven trees do not make a forest, and neither do seventy, but seven thousand are a bit closer," said Beuys. Despite numerous challenges, he remained firm in his determination to have 7,000 trees planted. Thanks to him, these days, the people of Kassel enjoy magnificent oak trees throughout their city.
choices: a small effort is enough to create meaningful change
only a massive scale of action can achieve the intended goal
the number of trees matters less than their quality
planting trees in stages is more effective than all at once
forests naturally grow without human intervention over time
solution: ② 밑줄 친 '"Seven trees do not make a forest, and neither do seventy, but seven thousand are a bit closer"'는 일곱 그루도, 일흔 그루도 숲을 이루지 못하지만 7,000그루는 그에 가깝다는 뜻으로, 밑줄 앞에서 Beuys가 도시 전체에 7,000그루의 참나무를 심겠다는 아이디어를 제안했다고 했고 뒤에 수많은 어려움에도 그 결심이 확고했다는 내용이 이어지고 있으므로 밑줄 친 부분에는 '충분히 큰 규모의 행동만이 목표를 이룰 수 있다'라는 의미가 와야 자연스럽다. 따라서 ②가 정답이다.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
By 1986, approximately 5,500 trees ⓐhad been planted. Unfortunately, Joseph Beuys died at the age of sixty-four, before his final project ⓑwas completed. As a legacy of his will, his family and the citizens continued to plant the ⓒremained trees. Finally, his son, Wenzel Beuys, planted the final tree in 1987. The massive project took five years ⓓto complete. The project would not have been realized without the active participation of the Kassel residents. Rows of large oak trees now
ⓔprovide spectacular views in and around Kassel.
solution: ③ remained → remaining 명사 trees를 앞에서 수식하는 역할을 하므로 형용사 역할의 현재분사 remaining이 와야 한다. remained는 동사의 과거형 또는 과거분사로, 명사를 수식하는 형용사적 용법으로 쓰일 수 없다. 따라서 ③이 정답이다. ① 문맥상 1986년 이전의 완료된 사실을 나타내는 과거완료 수동태 had been planted가 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 'before his final project was completed'에서 his final project가 완료되는 대상이므로 수동태 was completed가 올바르게 쓰였다. ④ 'take + 시간 + to-부정사' 구문에서 to complete가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 주어 Rows(복수)에 맞춰 복수 동사 provide가 올바르게 쓰였다.

body:
밑줄 친 우리말과 일치하도록 아래의 단어들을 바르게 배 열하시오.
Beuys started the 7000 Oaks project by planting a small oak tree with a basalt column in front of an art museum. The oak tree illustrated nature's constant growth, while the basalt column signified a man-made structure that remains constant. He sought to demonstrate that man- made buildings and nature could coexist in harmony by contrasting the oak tree with the basalt column. Beuys did not intend to plant all the trees by himself. He wanted to invite the citizens of Kassel to participate in the planting of the trees. After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. Beuys는 그 프 로젝트의 성공에 공동체의 참여가 필수적이라고 믿었다.
보기 that / believed / participation / essential / Beuys / was / community / to / the / project's / success
→
answer: Beuys believed that community participation was essential to the project's success.
solution: believe + that절' 구조를 사용하여 'Beuys believed that'으로 시작한다. that절의 주어는 'community participation', 동사는 'was', 보어는 'essential to the project's success'로 이어지는 단순 2형식 문장이다. 천재(조) 5과

Kassel is a small city located in central Germany. If you walk around Kassel, you will encounter rows of oak trees with stone columns beside them. choices: Kassel is a small city in central Germany.
Kassel has rows of pine trees along its streets.
Joseph Beuys planned to plant 700 oak trees.

solution: ① Kassel은 독일 중부에 위치한 작은 도시라고 지문 첫 문장에 명시되어 있으므로 일치한다. 따라서 ①이 정답이다. ② 지문에서 Kassel의 나무는 참나무(oak trees)라고 했으므로 소나무(pine trees)라는 설명은 일치하지 않는다. ③ Joseph Beuys가 계획한 나무의 수는 7,000그루이며, 700그루가 아니므로 일치하지 않는다. ④ 지문에서 Joseph Beuys는 수많은 어려움에도 불구하고 결심을 굳게 유지했다고 했으므로 포기했다는 설명은 정반대이다. ⑤ 지문에서 참나무는 도시 전역(throughout the city)에 있다고 했으므로 일부 지역에만 있다는 설명은 일치하지 않는다.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
During the dreadful World War II, Kassel was the heart of German military production. This resulted in the entire city ⓐto bomb to the ground and destroyed. After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the adversities of the war. It went through rapid industrialization and urbanization. This provided convenience for the citizens but caused ⓑsignificance environmental damage, too. In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. Beuys saw the environmental damage and thought about what he could do ⓒto advocate for nature through his work. He wanted to speak about the need to turn destructive energy for waging wars into a constructive one to build a better society. In addition, Beuys, who was deeply aware of the importance of ⓓpreserve and restoring nature, wished to reshape the relationship between humans and nature. To make this happen, he proposed the project, "7000 Oaks." In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each ⓔpairing with a basalt column.
solution: ③ 'thought about what he could do to advocate for nature'에서 to advocate는 'what he could do'를 수식하는 부사적 용법의 to부정사로, 목적의 의미를 나타내며 어법상 올바르게 쓰였다. ① to bomb → being bombed 'result in + 목적어 + 분사' 구조에서 목적어인 'the entire city'는 폭격을 당하는 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 being bombed가 와야 한다. 능동의 의미인 to bomb은 문맥상 적절하지 않다. ② significance → significant 명사 'environmental damage'를 수식하는 자리이므로 명사 significance가 아닌 형용사 significant가 와야 한다. ④ preserve → preserving 전치사 of의 목적어 자리이므로 동사원형 preserve가 아닌 동명사 preserving이 와야 한다. 'and restoring'과의 병렬 구조도 동명사 형태를 요구한다. ⑤ pairing → paired 'each paired with a basalt column'은 분사구문으로, each(= each oak tree)가 basalt column과 짝지어지는 수동 관계이므로 현재분사 pairing이 아닌 과거분사 paired가 와야 한다.

body:
다음 글의 내용을 다음과 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸(A), (B)에 들어갈 말을 글에서 찾아 각각 한 단어로 쓰시오.
At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers' money on such a "useless" project. They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. Above all, people questioned whether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. He held workshops to educate people about the project's importance and how they could contribute. He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them to take part. His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference. Despite initial (A) _____ and doubt about the 7000 Oaks project, Beuys persistently tried to (B) as many people as possible and convinced them that everyone could make a difference.
(A) _____
(B) _____
solution: (A)에는 프로젝트에 대한 초기 반발을 나타내는 말이 필요하므로 지문의 'opposition'이 적절하다. (B)에는 Beuys가 가능한 한 많은 사람들에게 접근하려 했다는 내용을 나타내는 말이 필요하므로 지문의 'reach out to'에서 'reach'가 적절하다.

body:
다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
During the dreadful World War II, Kassel was the heart of German military production. This resulted in the entire city being bombed to the ground and destroyed. After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the adversities of the war. It went through rapid industrialization and urbanization. This provided convenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too. In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. He wanted to speak about the need to turn destructive energy for waging wars into a constructive one to build a better society. To make this happen, he proposed the project, "7000 Oaks." In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each paired with a basalt column.
choices: the industrial history of postwar Kassel
Beuys's project to reconnect Kassel with nature after wartime and industrial damage
the specific techniques Beuys used to select oak tree locations
the political consequences of World War II bombing campaigns
how basalt columns are manufactured for public art

ⓐencounter: to meet or find something by chance

ⓒdetermination: the quality of being decided and not giving up

solution: ② 제시된 풀이 '잘 알려지지 않거나 중요하지 않은'은 prominent(저명한, 두드러진)의 뜻과 반대이다. prominent의 올바른 풀이는 'well known and important or easy to notice(잘 알려져 있고 중요하거나 눈에 띄는)'이다. ① encounter(마주치다): 우연히 무언가를 만나거나 발견하다 ③ determination(결심, 의지): 결정하고 포기하지 않는 성질 ④ challenge(어려움, 도전): 누군가의 능력을 시험하는 어려운 상황 ⑤ magnificent(웅장한, 훌륭한): 매우 인상적이고 아름다운 천재(조) 5과

Beuys started the 7000 Oaks project by planting a small oak tree with a basalt column in front of an art museum. The oak tree illustrated nature's constant growth, while the basalt column signified a man-made structure that remains constant. He sought to demonstrate that man- _____ . made buildings and nature could coexist in harmony by contrasting the oak tree with the basalt column. Beuys did not intend to plant all the trees by himself. He wanted to invite the citizens of Kassel to participate in the planting of the trees. After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. Beuys believed that community participation was essential to the project's success.
choices: Beuys planted the first oak tree in front of an art museum.
The oak tree represented nature's constant growth.
Beuys planned to plant all 7,000 trees by himself.
The 6,999 basalt columns were piled up in a public square.
Beuys believed community participation was essential to the project. 2회차 실전 모의고사
solution: ③ 지문에서 Beuys는 모든 나무를 혼자 심으려 하지 않았고 (did not intend to plant all the trees by himself), 카셀 시민들을 나무 심기에 참여시키고 싶었다고 했으므로, 혼자 심으려 했다는 선택지는 지문의 내용과 일치하지 않는다. ① 지문 첫 문장에서 Beuys가 미술관 앞에 작은 참나무를 심으며 프로젝트를 시작했다는 내용과 일치한다. ② 지문에서 참나무는 자연의 지속적인 성장을 나타냈다 (illustrated nature's constant growth)는 내용과 일치한다. ④ 지문에서 6,999개의 현무암 기둥을 박물관 앞 공공 광장에 쌓아 두었다는 내용과 일치한다. ⑤ 지문 마지막 문장에서 Beuys는 공동체 참여가 프로젝트의 성공에 필수적이라고 믿었다는 내용과 일치한다.

By 1986, approximately 5,500 trees ⓐ _____ . Unfortunately, Joseph Beuys died at the age of sixty-four, before his final project ⓑ _____ . 조건 1. ⓐ는 과거완료 수동태(had been + p.p.) 형태 로, 정확히 3단어로 쓸 것
2. ⓑ는 수동태 과거시제(was + p.p.) 형태로, 정 확히 2단어로 쓸 것
3. ⓒ는 능동태 과거시제로 쓰고 목적을 나타내는 to부정사를 포함하여, 정확히 5단어로 쓸 것
보기 plant / complete (x 2) / take / five / years / to
ⓐ _____
ⓑ _____
ⓒ _____
answer: ⓐ had been planted ⓑ was completed ⓒ took five years to complete
solution: ⓐ had been planted 1986년이라는 과거 시점보다 그 이전에 나무 심기가 이미 진행되어 온 결과를 나타내야 하므로, 특정 과거 시점보다 앞선 일을 나타내는 과거완료(had + p.p.)가 필요하다. 또한 나무가 심'는' 주체가 아니라 심'어지는' 대상이므로 수동태가 되어야 하여, 'had'와 과거분사 사이에 'been'을 넣은 'had been planted'가 적절하다. ⓑ was completed 문장 전체가 과거 시점(died)을 기준으로 서술되므로 과거시제가 필요하며, 프로젝트가 '완료하는' 주체가 아니라 '완료되는' 대상이므로 수동태가 되어야 한다. 따라서 be동사의 과거형 'was'와 과거분사 'completed'를 결합한 'was completed'가 적절하다. ⓒ took five years to complete 주어인 'The massive project'가 5년이라는 시간을 '소요한' 주체이므로 수동태가 아닌 능동태가 필요하며, 문장 전체가 과거 시제로 서술되므로 'take'를 과거형 'took'으로 바꿔야 한다. 이어서 소요된 기간 'five years'를 목적어로 쓰고, '완성하는 데'라는 목적의 의미를 나타내는 to부정사 'to complete'를 붙여 'took five years to complete'를 완성한다. 천재(조) 5과

body:
다음 중 영영풀이와 단어가 잘못 연결된 것은?
During the dreadful World War II, Kassel was the heart of German military production. This resulted in the entire city being bombed to the ground and destroyed. After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the adversities of the war. It went through rapid industrialization and urbanization. This provided convenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too. In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. Beuys saw the environmental damage and thought about what he could do to advocate for nature through his work. He wanted to speak about the need to turn destructive energy for waging wars into a constructive one to build a better society. In addition, Beuys, who was deeply aware of the importance of preserving and restoring nature, wished to reshape the relationship between humans and nature. To make this happen, he proposed the project, "7000 Oaks." In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each paired with a basalt column.
ⓐadversity: a situation in which things are easy and comfortable
ⓑadvocate: to publicly support or recommend a cause or idea
ⓒdestructive: causing a lot of damage or harm
ⓓpreserve: to keep something safe from harm or decay
ⓔambitious: involving a lot of effort and determination to achieve something difficult 2회차 실전 모의고사
solution: ① 제시된 풀이 'a situation in which things are easy and comfortable(상황이 쉽고 편안한 상태)'는 adversity(역경)의 뜻과 반대이다. adversity의 올바른 풀이는 'a difficult or unpleasant situation(어렵거나 힘든 상황)'이다. ② advocate(지지하다): 어떤 주장이나 아이디어를 공개적으로 지지하거나 추천하다 ③ destructive(파괴적인): 많은 피해나 손상을 일으키는 ④ preserve(보존하다): 어떤 것을 해나 부패로부터 안전하게 지키다 ⑤ ambitious(야심 찬): 어려운 것을 이루기 위해 많은 노력과 결단을 필요로 하는

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Taean, known for its beautiful sandy beaches and rocky landscapes, went through a tragic disaster. In 2007, an oil tanker had an accident in the ocean near Taean, resulting in a massive oil spill of about 12,000 kl into nearby waters. The government declared Taean a special disaster area. The scale of the spill was enormous, covering over 1,200 km of coastline. The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. Birds and underwater organisms died, and the local population was in danger. In the face of this crisis, something tremendous happened. Volunteers from all over the country rallied together in a unified effort to undertake the seemingly impossible task. In order to transport sand polluted by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain. Shoulder to shoulder, they passed buckets of sand and oil from one person to another. They worked tirelessly, day and night. As the days turned into weeks, the persistent efforts of these dedicated volunteers began to bear fruit. The shoreline that had once been soaked in oil ultimately began to change, as steadily washed away the toxic contamination. According to the Korean government, this was one of the largest volunteer efforts to have ever taken place in Asia. Their actions demonstrated that miraculous things could indeed be achieved, and triumph against disaster is possible when people unite for a greater purpose.
choices: the power of advanced technology
the collective might of their labor
the government's emergency measures
the scale of the environmental damage
the continuous rainfall over the region 2회차 실전 모의고사 유형보충독해

solution: ③ⓒ 'polluted by oil'은 앞의 명사 sand를 수식하는 과거분사구로, sand가 기름에 의해 오염된 것이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 polluted가 올바르게 쓰였다. ①ⓐ resulted in → resulting in 'an oil tanker had an accident'라는 주절의 주어(an oil tanker)가 기름 유출을 초래하는 능동의 의미를 나타내며, 앞 절의 결과를 부가적으로 설명하는 분사구문이므로 과거분사 resulted가 아니라 현재분사 resulting으로 고쳐야 한다. ②ⓑ tremendously → tremendous 'something, anything, nothing' 등 -thing으로 끝나는 대명사를 수식하는 형용사는 반드시 후치 수식하며, 수식어 자리에는 형용사가 와야 한다. -thing으로 끝나는 대명사 (something)는 부사가 아닌 형용사로 후치 수식해야 하므로, 형용사 tremendous로 고쳐야 한다. ④ⓓ has once been soaked → had once been soaked 관계대명사 that이 이끄는 절에서 해안선이 기름에 잠겼던 것은 과거의 이야기로, 주절의 동사 'began to change'(과거) 보다 이전에 일어난 일이므로 과거완료 had been soaked가 와야 한다. 현재완료 has been soaked는 시제상 맞지 않으므로 틀렸다. ⑤ⓔ to have ever took → to have ever taken 완료부정사(to have + p.p.) 구문에서 have 뒤에는 반드시 과거분사가 와야 한다. take의 과거분사는 taken이므로 took를 taken으로 고쳐야 한다. 천재(조) 5과

Taean, known for its beautiful sandy beaches and rocky landscapes, went through a tragic disaster. In 2007, an oil tanker had an accident in the ocean near Taean, resulting in a massive oil spill of about 12,000 kl into nearby waters. The government declared Taean a special disaster area. The scale of the spill was enormous, covering over 1,200 km of coastline. The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. Birds and underwater organisms died, and the local population was in danger. In the face of this crisis, something tremendous happened. Volunteers from all over the country rallied together in a unified effort to undertake the seemingly impossible task. In order to transport sand polluted by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain. Shoulder to shoulder, they passed buckets of sand and oil from one person to another. They worked tirelessly, day and night. As the days turned into weeks, the persistent efforts of these dedicated volunteers began to bear fruit. The shoreline that had once been soaked in oil ultimately began to change, as the collective might of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination. According to the Korean government, this was one of the largest volunteer efforts to have ever taken place in Asia. Their actions demonstrated that miraculous things could indeed be achieved, and triumph against disaster is possible when people unite for a greater purpose.

solution: 정답 문장은 'The shoreline that had once been soaked in oil ultimately began to change, as the collective might of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination.'이다. 먼저, 관계대명사 조건을 충족하기 위해 'The shoreline'을 선행사로 하는 관계대명사 'that'을 사용하여 'that had once been soaked in oil'이라는 관계대명사절을 구성한다. 박스에 제공된 'soak'은 과거완료 수동태 형태인 'had been soaked'로 어형을 변형해야 한다. 다음으로, 접속사(as) 조건을 충족하기 위해 이유·동시 상황을 나타내는 접속사 'as'를 사용하여 'as the collective might of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination'이라는 부사절을 연결한다. 박스에 제공된 'wash away'는 과거 시제 'washed away'로 어형을 변형해야 하며, 'begin'은 'began'으로, 'change'는 원형 그대로 'to change'(begin의 목적어로 to부정사)로 처리한다. 박스의 모든 단어(shoreline, once, soak→soaked, oil, ultimately, begin→began, change, collective, might, labor, steadily, wash away→washed away, toxic contamination)가 정답 문장에 포함되어 있는지 확인한다.

다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers' money on such a "useless" project. They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. Above all, people questioned ⓐwhether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts ⓑto reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. He held workshops to educate people about the project's importance and ⓒhow they could contribute. He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them to take part. His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference. Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. The community's involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and ⓓother provided planting sites. People took care of the trees after they were planted. They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. The project brought the community together during the process. People who ⓔhad never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. They shared a common goal and worked towards it. The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: 일부 시민들은 나무 심기가 도시에서 무의미한 일이라고 여 기며 반대했다.
Beuys는 워크숍뿐 아니라 개별적인 대화를 통해서도 시민 들을 설득하고자 했다.
카셀 시장은 프로젝트에 반대하는 시민들의 의견에 따라 지 원을 중단했다.
나무를 심을 장소는 주민뿐 아니라 학교와 지역 단체를 통해 서도 마련되었다.
함께 나무를 심는 과정에서 낯선 사람들 사이에 협력하려는 마음이 생겨났다.
solution: ③ 지문에서는 시장이 처음부터 프로젝트에 재정적 지원을 했다고 언급될 뿐, 이후 지원을 중단했다는 내용은 없다. 즉, 시민들의 반대 여론에 따라 지원을 중단했다는 선택지는 지문에서 언급되지 않은 내용이다. ① 일부 시민들이 도시에 나무를 심는 것이 무의미하다고 여기며 반대했다는 내용과 일치한다. ② Beuys가 워크숍뿐 아니라 사람들과 1:1로 대화하며 설득하려 했다는 내용과 일치한다. ④ 주민, 지역사회 협의회, 학교, 지역 단체 등이 나무 심을 장소를 제공했다는 내용과 일치한다. ⑤ 서로 만난 적 없던 사람들이 나무를 함께 심으며 협력하게 되었다는 내용과 일치한다.

다음 글을 읽고, 아래 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말 을 아래 〈조건〉에 맞게 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers' money on such a "useless" project. They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. Above all, people questioned if 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. He held workshops to educate people about the project's importance and how they could contribute. He even talked to people individually about the project and encouraged them to take part. His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference. Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. The community's involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. People took care of the trees after they were planted. They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. The project brought the community together during the process. People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees toward a common goal. The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging. Beuys's tireless efforts, (A) _____ as many citizens as possible, eventually won over Kassel's residents, and their shared care for the trees ultimately succeeded in (B) _____ .
조건 1. (A), (B) 모두 본문에 쓰인 단어를 활용하되, 문 맥에 맞게 어법상 형태를 변형할 것
2. (A)는 정확히 3단어, (B)는 정확히 4단어의 구 (phrase)로 쓸 것
(A) _____
(B) _____
answer: (A) reaching out to (B) bringing the community together
solution: (A) 본문의 'continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible'에서 동사원형 'reach'를 가져오되, 이 요약문에서는 콤마로 이어져 'efforts'를 부가적으로 수식하는 분사구문 자리이므로 'reach'를 현재분사형 'reaching'으로 변형하고, 이어지는 'out to'는 그대로 붙여 'reaching out to'를 완성한다. (B) 본문의 'The project brought the community together'에서 동사 'brought'(bring의 과거형)를 가져오되, 이 요약문에서는 전치사 'in'의 목적어 자리이므로 'brought'를 동명사형 'bringing'으로 변형하고, 나머지 'the community together'는 본문 그대로 이어 'bringing the community together'를 완성한다.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
solution: ②ⓑ what → that 'demonstrate'의 목적어로 완전한 절이 이어지고 있다. what은 뒤에 불완전한 절을 이끄는 반면, 이 문장은 주어와 동사를 모두 갖춘 완전한 절이므로 명사절 접속사 that으로 고쳐야 한다. ① 참나무와 현무암 기둥의 대조되는 성질을 연결하는 문맥이므로, 대조를 나타내는 접속사 while이 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ '그 혼자서'라는 의미의 관용 표현이므로, 재귀대명사를 이용한 by himself가 올바르게 쓰였다. ④ 이어동사(구동사) pile up의 목적어가 대명사 them이므로, 이어동사 사이에 대명사가 위치하는 어순인 piled them up이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 'urged + 목적어 + to부정사'의 5형식 구조이며, 뒤의 to place와 병렬 연결되는 문맥이므로 to plant가 올바르게 쓰였다.

다음 글의 내용을 요약할 때 빈칸 (A)~(F)에 들어갈 단어를
<보기>에서 골라 쓰시오. (단, 필요시 단어 변형 가능)
Beuys started the 7000 Oaks project by planting a small oak tree with a basalt column in front of an art museum. The oak tree illustrated nature's constant growth, while the basalt column signified a man-made structure that remains constant. He sought to demonstrate that man- made buildings and nature could coexist in harmony by contrasting the oak tree with the basalt column. Beuys did not intend to plant all the trees by himself. He wanted to invite the citizens of Kassel to participate in the planting of the trees. After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. Beuys believed that community participation was essential to the project's success. 3회차 실전 모의고사 While one object in the project represents (A)
over time, the other represents (B) to show (C) _____ . This meaningful work could not be completed alone, as it was designed as a(n) (D) _____ effort that (E) _____ heavily on community (F) .
보기 individual / conflict / collective / rely / change / permanence / harmony / participation / temporary
(A) _____ (B) _____ (C) _____ (D) _____ (E) _____ (F) _____
answer: (A) change (B) permanence (C) harmony (D) collective (E) relies (F) participation
solution: (A), (B) 본문의 'The oak tree illustrated nature's constant growth, while the basalt column signified a man-made structure that remains constant'라는 표현을 통해, 참나무는 시간에 따라 변화하는 성질을, 현무암 기둥은 변하지 않는 성질을 상징한다는 것을 알 수 있으므로 (A)에는 'change(변화)', (B)에는 'permanence(불변)'가 가장 적절하다. (C) 본문의 'man-made buildings and nature could coexist in harmony'라는 표현을 통해 Beuys가 인공물과 자연의 조화를 보여주고자 했다는 것을 알 수 있으므로 'harmony(조화)'가 가장 적절하다. (D), (E), (F) 본문에서 Beuys가 모든 나무를 혼자 심으려 하지 않았고 시민들의 참여를 지속적으로 유도했으며, 마지막 문장에서 'community participation was essential to the project's success'라고 명시하고 있다. 이를 통해 이 프로젝트가 개인이 아닌 공동의 노력이었고 시민 참여에 크게 의존했다는 것을 알 수 있으므로, (D)에는 'collective(공동의)', (E)에는 rely를 3인칭 단수형으로 변형한 'relies(의존하다)', (F)에는 'participation(참여)'이 가장 적절하다.

다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Kassel is a small city located in central Germany. If you walk around Kassel, you will encounter rows of oak trees with stone columns beside them. This all began with a prominent German artist named Joseph Beuys, who came up with the idea to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout the city. "Seven trees do not make a forest, and neither do seventy, but seven thousand are a bit closer," said Beuys. (가)[Although / Despite] numerous challenges, he remained firm in his ⓐresolve to have 7,000 trees planted. Thanks to him, these days, the people of Kassel enjoy magnificent oak trees throughout their city.
(A) In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. Beuys saw the environmental damage and thought about what he could do to ⓑoppose for nature through his work. _____ . (나)[In addition / In addition to], Beuys, who was deeply aware of the importance of preserving and restoring nature, wished to ⓒtransform the relationship between humans and nature.
(B) To make this happen, he ⓓput forward the project, "7000 Oaks." In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each paired with a basalt column.
(C) (다)[During / For] the dreadful World War II, Kassel was the heart of German military production. This resulted in the entire city being bombed to the ground and destroyed. After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the adversities of the war. It went through rapid industrialization and ⓔdeurbanization. This provided convenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too.

This provided convenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too.

글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 어색한 것끼 리 짝지어진 것은?
solution: ⓑ oppose는 '반대하다'라는 뜻이다. 그러나 본문에서는 Beuys가 자연을 보호하기 위해 자신의 예술 활동을 통해 자연을 옹호(advocate for nature)하려 했다고 설명한다. 따라서 oppose는 문맥에 맞지 않으며, advocate (for)가 와야 한다. ⓔ deurbanization은 '탈도시화'를 의미한다. 그러나 글에서는 전쟁 이후 Kassel이 rapid industrialization and urbanization(급속한 산업화와 도시화)를 겪었고, 그 결과 환경 훼손이 발생했다고 설명한다. 따라서 deurbanization은 문맥에 맞지 않으며, urbanization이 와야 한다. ⓐ resolve는 '굳은 결의, 확고한 의지'를 의미하며, 원문의 determination과 같은 뜻으로 문맥에 적절하다. ⓒ transform은 '변화시키다, 바꾸다'라는 뜻으로, 원문의 reshape와 의미가 같으므로 적절하다. ⓓ put forward는 '제안하다'라는 뜻으로, 원문의 proposed와 같은 의미이므로 문맥에 알맞다.

solution: (가) Despite Despite는 전치사이므로 뒤에 명사(구)가 와야 한다. 뒤의 numerous challenges는 명사구이므로 Despite numerous challenges가 올바른 표현이다. 반면 Although는 접속사이므로 뒤에 주어 + 동사가 있는 절이 와야 하므로 사용할 수 없다. solution: 가장 ~한 것들 중 하나'라는 의미의 최상급 표현 'one of the + 최상급 + 복수명사' 구조를 사용하여 large를 largest로 쓴다. 또한 '지금까지 일어난 적이 있는'이라는 의미로, 주절의 시제(was)보다 앞서거나 그 시점까지 누적된 경험을 나타내야 하므로 완료부정사 'to have + p.p.' 형태를 써야 한다. 이에 따라 조건에서 요구한 추가 단어로 have를 넣고, take를 과거분사 taken으로 형태 변형하여 'to have ever taken place'로 완성한다.

By 1986, approximately 5,500 trees had been planted. Unfortunately, Joseph Beuys died at the age of sixty-four, before his final project was completed. As a legacy of his
ⓐfinal wishes, his family and the citizens continued to plant the remaining trees. Finally, his son, Wenzel Beuys, planted the final tree in 1987. The ⓑenormous project took five years to complete. The project would not have been realized without the active participation of the Kassel residents. Rows of large oak trees now provide
ⓒimpressive views in and around Kassel. The 7000 Oaks project has ⓓthrived and continues to inspire Kassel residents and visitors from all over the world. body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Beuys started the 7000 Oaks project by planting a small oak tree with a basalt column in front of an art museum. The oak tree illustrated nature's constant growth, while the basalt column signified a man-made structure that remains ⓐconstantly. He sought to demonstrate that man-made buildings and nature could coexist in harmony by contrasting the oak tree with the basalt column.
(A) At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers' money on such a "useless" project. They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. Above all, people questioned whether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. He held workshops to educate people about the project's importance and how they could contribute. He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them ⓑtaking part. His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability ⓒto make a difference.
(B) Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. The community's involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. People took care of the trees after they were planted. They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. The project brought the community together
ⓓduring the process. People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. They shared a common goal and worked towards it. The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.
(C) Beuys did not intend to plant all the trees by ⓔhim. He wanted to invite the citizens of Kassel to participate in the planting of the trees. After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. Beuys believed that _____ .

다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Beuys started the 7000 Oaks project by planting a small oak tree with a basalt column in front of an art museum. He held workshops to educate people about the project's importance and how they could contribute. He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them ⓑtaking part. His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability ⓒto make a difference.

ⓓduring the process. People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. They shared a common goal and worked towards it. The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.

Beuys believed that _____ .

글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 어법상 어색한 것을 바르게 고친 것 끼리 짝지어진 것은?
choices: ⓐ constantly → constant ⓓ during → for ⓔ him → himself
ⓑ taking → take ⓒ to make → make ⓓ during → for
ⓒ to make → make ⓓ during → for ⓔ him → himself
ⓐ constantly → constant ⓑ taking → to take ⓔ him → himself
ⓑ taking → take ⓒ to make → make ⓔ him → himself
solution: ⓐ constantly → constant a man-made structure that remains ⓐconstantly는 어색하다. remain은 뒤에 형용사 보어를 취하므로 constant가 와야 한다. 그러므로, remains constant가 맞다. ⓑ taking → to take encourage + 목적어 + to부정사의 형태를 취한다. 따라서 encouraged them taking part가 아니라 encouraged them to take part가 되어야 한다. ⓒ to make a difference the ability to + 동사원형은 올바른 표현이다. 그러므로, the ability to make a difference가 맞다. ⓓ during the process during + 기간/과정은 올바른 표현이다. 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 영영 풀이로 옳은 것은?
7000 Oaks Make a Forest Kassel is a small city located in central Germany. If you walk around Kassel, you will encounter rows of oak trees with stone columns beside them. This all began with a prominent German artist named Joseph Beuys, who came up with the idea to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout the city. "Seven trees do not make a forest, and neither do seventy, but seven thousand are a bit closer," said Beuys. Despite numerous challenges, he remained firm in his determination to have 7,000 trees planted. Thanks to him, these days, the people of Kassel enjoy magnificent oak trees throughout their city. 4회차 실전 모의고사 During the dreadful World War II, Kassel was the heart of German military production. This resulted in the entire city being bombed to the ground and destroyed. After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the adversities of the war. It went through rapid industrialization and urbanization. This provided convenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too. In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. Beuys saw the environmental damage and thought about what he could do to advocate for nature through his work. He wanted to speak about the need to turn destructive energy for waging wars into a constructive one to build a better society. In addition, Beuys, who was deeply aware of the importance of preserving and restoring nature, wished to reshape the relationship between humans and nature. To make this happen, he proposed the project, "7000 Oaks." In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each paired with a basalt column.
choices: prominent : having very little importance or influence
magnificent : extremely impressive, beautiful, or grand
dreadful : pleasant and enjoyable
advocate : to prevent people from supporting an idea
basalt : a soft type of wood commonly used to make furniture
solution: ② magnificent magnificent는 extremely impressive, beautiful, or grand(매우 훌륭한, 장엄한, 아름다운)이라는 뜻으로, 본문에서 magnificent oak trees는 '장엄한 참나무들'이라는 의미이다. ① prominent prominent는 well-known, important, or easily noticed(유명한, 중요한, 두드러진)이라는 뜻이다. 제시된 having very little importance or influence는 반대 의미이다. ③ dreadful dreadful는 very bad, terrible, or causing fear(끔찍한, 무서운)을 의미한다. pleasant and enjoyable는 반대 의미이다. ④ advocate advocate는 to publicly support or recommend an idea or cause(지지하다, 옹호하다)라는 뜻이다. 제시된 풀이는 '지지를 막다'라는 반대 의미이다. ⑤ basalt basalt는 a type of dark volcanic rock(현무암)을 의미한다. 제시된 a soft type of wood는 전혀 다른 의미이다.

After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the ⓐadversities of the war. It went through rapid industrialization and urbanization. This provided ⓑinconvenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too. In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. Beuys saw the environmental damage and thought about what he could do to ⓒadvocate for nature through his work. He wanted to speak about the need to turn destructive energy for ⓓwaging wars into a constructive one to build a better society. In addition, Beuys, who was deeply aware of the importance of preserving and restoring nature, wished to ⓔreshape the relationship between humans and nature. To make this happen, he proposed the project, "7000 Oaks." In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each paired with a basalt column.
solution: ② inconvenience → convenience 지문의 흐름상 산업화와 도시화가 시민들에게 '편의'를 제공했지만 동시에 환경 피해도 초래했다는 대조 구조가 되어야 한다. inconvenience(불편)는 문맥과 반대되는 의미이므로 convenience(편의)로 바꿔야 한다. ① adversities: 역경, 고난 ③ advocate: 옹호하다, 지지하다 ④ waging (wars): (전쟁을) 벌이는 ⑤ reshape: 재구성하다, 다시 형성하다 천재(조) 5과

body:
다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 단어들의 영영풀이로 옳지 않은 것은?
Kassel is a small city located in central Germany. If you walk around Kassel, you will ⓐencounter rows of oak trees with stone ⓑcolumns beside them. This all began with a ⓒprominent German artist named Joseph Beuys, who came up with the idea to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout the city. "Seven trees do not make a forest, and neither do seventy, but seven thousand are a bit closer," said Beuys. Despite numerous challenges, he remained firm in his ⓓdetermination to have 7,000 trees planted. Thanks to him, these days, the people of Kassel enjoy ⓔmagnificent oak trees throughout their city.
choices: ⓐ: to meet or experience something, often unexpectedly
ⓑ: a tall vertical structure, often used to support a building
ⓒ: important or famous, and therefore well known
ⓓ: a strong feeling of doubt that prevents action
ⓔ: extremely beautiful and impressive
solution: ④ determination → a strong feeling of confidence that leads to continued action 지문의 흐름상 'determination'은 수많은 어려움에도 불구하고 7천 그루를 심겠다는 목표를 굽히지 않았다는 의미이므로 '망설임 없이 밀고 나가려는 굳은 의지'를 뜻해야 한다. 그런데 제시된 영영풀이는 '행동을 막는 의심의 감정 (doubt that prevents action)'으로, determination의 실제 의미와 정반대되므로 옳지 않다. ① encounter: 우연히 또는 뜻하지 않게 무언가를 마주치다 ② column: 건물을 지탱하는 데 쓰이는 높은 수직 구조물 ③ prominent: 중요하거나 유명해서 잘 알려진 ⑤ magnificent: 매우 아름답고 인상적인

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 고르시오.
① ⓐ
② ⓑ
③ ⓒ

solution: ②ⓑ with → for 문맥상 '시민들에게 편의를 제공했다'는 의미이다. provide A for B는 'B에게 A를 제공하다'라는 뜻으로, 이때 전치사는 with가 아닌 for를 써야 한다. ⑤ⓔ pairing → paired 문맥상 '각 나무가 현무암 기둥과 짝지어진'이라는 수동의 의미이다. 나무가 스스로 짝짓는 것이 아니라 짝지어지는 대상이므로 수동을 나타내는 과거분사 paired로 고쳐야 한다. ① 'the entire city'가 동명사 being bombed의 의미상 주어이며 도시가 폭격을 당하는 수동의 의미이므로, being bombed가 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ do의 목적어 역할을 겸하는 의문사 what이 명사절을 이끌고 있으므로, what이 올바르게 쓰였다. ④ wish가 목적어로 to부정사를 취하는 동사이므로, to reshape가 올바르게 쓰였다.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 가리키는 대상이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers' money on such a "useless" project.
ⓐThey complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. Above all, people questioned whether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include ⓑthem in the project. He held workshops to educate people about the project's importance and how they could contribute. He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged ⓒthem to take part. His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference. Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. The community's involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. People took care of the trees after ⓓthey were planted. ⓔThey watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm.
solution: ⓓ 바로 앞 명사인 'the trees'(나무들)를 가리키므로, 사람이 아닌 대상을 가리킨다는 점에서 나머지 넷과 다르다. ⓐ 바로 앞 문장의 'some people'(세금 낭비를 이유로 반대하는 사람들)을 가리킨다. ⓑ 앞서 언급된 'as many individuals as possible'(보이스가 참여시키려 한 사람들)을 가리킨다. ⓒ 같은 문장 앞부분의 'people'(보이스가 일대일로 대화를 나눈 사람들)을 가리킨다. ⓔ 바로 앞 문장의 'People'(나무를 돌본 주민들)을 가리킨다.

body:
다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
Beuys started the 7000 Oaks project by planting a small oak tree with a basalt column in front of an art museum. The oak tree illustrated nature's constant growth, while the basalt column signified a man-made structure that remains constant. He sought to demonstrate that man- made buildings and nature could coexist in harmony by contrasting the oak tree with the basalt column. Beuys did not intend to plant all the trees by himself. He wanted to invite the citizens of Kassel to participate in the planting of the trees. After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. Beuys believed that community participation was essential to the project's success.
choices: A Symbol of Harmony: Oak Tree and Basalt Column
Building 7000 Oaks Together: Beuys's Call for Citizen Participation
The History of Basalt Quarrying in Germany
Kassel's Public Squares: A Guide for Visitors
Documenta and Its Influence on Modern Art
solution: ② 시민들이 함께 나무를 심고 돌을 옮기도록 촉구한 보이스의 방식을 압축적으로 담아내므로 제목으로 가장 적절하다. ① 상징적 조화라는 것은 프로젝트 초반의 한 요소일 뿐 시민 참여라는 본문의 중심 흐름을 포괄하지 못한다. ③ 독일 현무암 채석의 역사는 본문에서 다루지 않는다. ④ 카셀 광장에 대한 방문 안내는 본문의 성격과 다르다. ⑤ 도쿠멘타가 현대 미술에 미친 영향은 본문에서 다루지 않는다.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 적절하면 O, 적절하지 않 으면 X를 쓰고, X인 경우 문맥에 맞게 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
Through his tireless efforts to spread his message,
ⓐthe increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and
ⓑjoined him in planting trees. The community's involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. People ⓒtake care of the trees after they were planted. They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. The project brought the community together during the process. People ⓓwho have never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. They shared a common goal and worked towards it. The project gave the residents of Kassel ⓔto a sense of community and belonging.
ⓐ( O, X ) _____ →
ⓑ( O, X ) _____ →
ⓒ( O, X ) _____ →
ⓓ( O, X ) _____ →

answer: ⓐ ( X ) the increasing number → an increasing number ⓑ ( O ) ⓒ ( X ) take → took ⓓ ( X ) who have never met → who had never met ⓔ ( X ) to a sense → a sense
solution: ⓐ 'an increasing number of + 복수명사(점점 더 많은 수의 ~)'는 정관사 'the'가 아니라 부정관사 'an'을 쓰는 고정된 표현이다. 특정하게 정해진 수를 가리키는 것이 아니라 계속 늘어나는 불특정한 수를 나타내야 하므로 'the'가 아니라 'an'이 되어야 한다. ⓑ 'join + 목적어 + in v-ing(~에서 …와 함께하다)' 구조가 정확히 쓰였으므로 어법상 옳다. ⓒ 문장 전체가 과거 시제로 서술되는 글이며, 뒤에 이어지는 'watered, trimmed, and protected'도 모두 과거형이므로 시제를 맞춰 'take'가 아니라 'took'이 되어야 한다. ⓓ 'People'을 수식하며 '한 번도 만난 적 없던 사람들'이라는 의미를 나타내야 하므로, 완료의 의미를 지닌 관계대명사절 'who had never met before'가 되어야 한다. 콤마 없이 분사구를 그대로 삽입한 'never having met before'는 이 문맥에서 자연스러운 수식 구조가 아니다. ⓔ 'give + 간접목적어 + 직접목적어(~에게 …을 주다)'의 4형식 구조이므로 간접목적어 'the residents of Kassel' 앞에 전치사 'to'가 올 필요가 없다. 전치사 'to' 없이 'gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging'이 되어야 한다. 천재(조) 5과

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
Taean, ⓐknown for its beautiful sandy beaches and rocky landscapes, went through a tragic disaster. In 2007, an oil tanker had an accident in the ocean near Taean, resulting in a massive oil spill of about 12,000 kl into nearby waters. The government declared Taean a special disaster area. The scale of the spill was enormous,
ⓑcovering over 1,200 km of coastline. The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. Birds and underwater organisms died, and the local population was in danger. In the face of this crisis, something tremendous happened. Volunteers from all over the country rallied together in a unified effort to undertake the seemingly impossible task. In order to transport sand
ⓒpolluting by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain. Shoulder to shoulder, they passed buckets of sand and oil from one person to another. They worked tirelessly, day and night. As the days turned into weeks, the persistent efforts of these dedicated volunteers began to bear fruit. The shoreline
ⓓthat had once been soaked in oil ultimately began to change, as the collective might of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination. According to the Korean government, this was one of the largest volunteer efforts to have ever ⓔtaken place in Asia.
choices: ⓔ 유형보충독해1
solution: ③ polluting → polluted 'sand'는 기름에 의해 오염된 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 polluted가 쓰여야 한다. polluting은 능동의 의미로 '모래가 (무언가를) 오염시키는'이라는 뜻이 되어 문맥에 맞지 않는다. ① Taean이 아름다운 해변과 바위 지형으로 '알려진' 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 known이 분사구문에 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문으로, 기름 유출이 해안선 1,200km를 '덮는' 능동의 의미이므로 현재분사 covering이 올바르게 쓰였다. ④ 선행사 'The shoreline'을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 'one of the largest volunteer efforts'를 수식하는 관계대명사절 안에서 완료부정사 'to have ever taken place'가 올바르게 쓰였다.

body:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것만을 짝지은 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
Taean, known for its beautiful sandy beaches and rocky landscapes, went through a tragic disaster. In 2007, an oil tanker ⓐhad had an accident in the ocean near Taean, resulting in a massive oil spill of about 12,000 kl into nearby waters. The government declared Taean a special disaster area. The scale of the spill was enormous,
ⓑcovered over 1,200 km of coastline. The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. Birds and underwater organisms died, and the local population was in danger. In the face of this crisis, something ⓒtremendously happened. Volunteers from all over the country rallied together in a unified effort to undertake the seemingly impossible task. ⓓSo as to transport sand polluted by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain. Shoulder to shoulder, they passed buckets of sand and oil from one person to another. They worked tirelessly, day and night. As the days turned into weeks, the persistent efforts of these dedicated volunteers began to bear fruit. The shoreline that had once ⓔbeen soaked in oil ultimately began to change, as the collective ⓕmight of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination.
choices: ⓒ, ⓔ, ⓕ 4회차 실전 모의고사 유형보충독해1
solution: ⓓ 'so as to + 동사원형'은 '~하기 위해'라는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사 표현으로, 'in order to'와 같은 의미로 쓰이는 정확한 구문이므로 옳다. ⓔ 해안선이 기름에 '적셔진' 시점이 그 이후 '변화하기 시작한' 시점보다 앞서므로, 주절의 과거시제보다 앞선 때를 나타내는 과거완료 수동태 'had once been soaked'가 정확히 쓰였으므로 옳다. ⓕ 'might'가 '힘, 위력'이라는 의미의 명사로 쓰여 'the collective might of their labor(그들 노동의 집단적 힘)'라는 명사구를 이루므로 어법상 옳다. ⓐ had had → had 2007년이라는 특정 과거 시점에 일어난 사건을 서술하는 단순 과거 문맥이며, 이보다 앞선 시점을 나타낼 근거가 없으므로 과거완료 'had had'가 아니라 단순과거 'had'가 되어야 한다. ⓑ covered → covering 콤마 뒤에서 앞 절 전체를 부가적으로 설명하는 분사구문 자리이므로, 유출 규모가 해안선을 '뒤덮은' 능동의 의미를 나타내는 현재분사 'covering'이 와야 한다. ⓒ tremendously → tremendous 'something' 뒤에서 이를 수식하는 자리이므로 부사 'tremendously'가 아니라 형용사 'tremendous'가 와야 한다.

body:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
Taean, known for its beautiful sandy beaches and rocky landscapes, went through a tragic disaster. In 2007, an oil tanker had an accident in the ocean near Taean, resulting in a massive oil spill of about 12,000 kl into nearby waters.
(A) The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. Birds and underwater organisms died, and the local population was in danger. In the face of this crisis, something tremendous happened.
(B) The government declared Taean a special disaster area. The scale of the spill was enormous, covering over 1,200 km of coastline.
(C) Volunteers from all over the country rallied together in a unified effort to undertake the seemingly impossible task. In order to transport sand polluted by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain.
choices: (C) - (A) - (B) 유형보충독해1
solution: 주어진 글에서 기름 유출 사고가 발생했다고 언급한다. (B)는 정부가 태안을 특별재난지역으로 선포하고 유출 규모가 해안선 1,200km에 달할 정도로 엄청났다는 구체적인 피해 규모를 제시하며 자연스럽게 이어진다. (A)는 이러한 유출이 환경에 끔찍한 영향을 미쳐 조류와 수중 생물이 죽고 지역 주민도 위험에 처했다는 내용과 함께, 이 위기 앞에서 놀라운 일이 일어났다는 전환을 제시한다. (C)에서 마지막으로 'Volunteers from all over the country rallied together'로 그 놀라운 일이 무엇인지 구체화하며 자원봉사자들이 모여 인간 띠를 만들었다는 내용으로 이어진다. 따라서, ③ (B) - (A) - (C) 가 정답으로 가장 알맞다.

body:
다음 밑줄 친 문장이 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
Taean, known for its beautiful sandy beaches and rocky landscapes, went through a tragic disaster. In 2007, an oil tanker had an accident in the ocean near Taean, resulting in a massive oil spill of about 12,000 kl into nearby waters. The government declared Taean a special disaster area. The scale of the spill was enormous, covering over 1,200 km of coastline. The oil spill had terrible effects on the environment. Birds and underwater organisms died, and the local population was in danger. In the face of this crisis, something tremendous happened. Volunteers from all over the country rallied together in a unified effort to undertake the seemingly impossible task. In order to transport sand polluted by oil away from the shoreline, these ordinary individuals formed a human chain. Shoulder to shoulder, they passed buckets of sand and oil from one person to another. They worked tirelessly, day and night. As the days turned into weeks, the persistent efforts of these dedicated volunteers began to bear fruit. The shoreline that had once been soaked in oil ultimately began to change, as the collective might of their labor steadily washed away the toxic contamination. According to the Korean government, this was one of the largest volunteer efforts to have ever taken place in Asia. Their actions demonstrated that what seemed impossible became proof of what ordinary hands, joined together, can do.
choices: The volunteers' efforts eventually failed to restore the coastline despite their persistence.
A task once thought unachievable was accomplished through the combined effort of everyday citizens.
Only trained professionals were capable of cleaning up the oil spill successfully.
The disaster revealed how little difference individual actions can make without government support.
The volunteers' work remained impossible even after their collective effort. 유형보충독해
solution: ② 밑줄 친 문장은 '불가능해 보였던 일이 함께 힘을 모은 평범한 사람들의 손이 해낼 수 있는 일의 증거가 되었다'는 뜻으로, 이는 도저히 불가능해 보였던 방제 작업이 평범한 시민들의 자발적인 협력을 통해 실제로 이루어졌다는 것을 함축하고 있으므로, 정답으로 가장 적절하다.
